verdict.line: You lose extended trades where Fiora parries your Q's follow-up attack and stacks her passive off your autos, but you win short all-ins started with E when her Riposte and both Lunge charges are down.

brief.thesis: Fiora's kit is built to punish the exact tool Garen leans on to trade: Riposte (W) parries the next basic attack, which is exactly what Decisive Strike's (Q) bonus-damage silence hit is, so throwing Q into an up Riposte gets it blocked for free while her Duelist passive heals her off every auto you land back. That's why Garen sits at 43.1% over 137 games with Fiora holding both the lane and solo-kill edge — the matchup is defensive until Garen's kit closes the gap with items.

theirWindow.what: Do not commit Q's empowered attack into her — she can parry it, negating the silence and bonus damage while denying your damage. Trade with E (Judgment) instead, since it's a spin, not a basic attack, and can't be parried.

yourWindow.when: Her Lunge (Q) and Riposte (W) are both down
yourWindow.what: All-in immediately: open with E for the AoE tick, then Q for the silence and speed burst. With Riposte down she has no way to block the attack, and with both Lunge charges spent she has no gap-close to escape or reset the fight.

start.why: Measured win rate on Doran's Blade (47.2% over 53 games) beats Doran's Shield (42.1% over 95 games) in this matchup despite lower pick rate — the extra auto damage helps you actually threaten her during your short trade windows instead of just surviving her poke.

boots.why: Highest measured win rate (47% over 117 games) and pick rate (72.2%); the attack speed feeds your auto-reset trades once you land E and gets you back into range faster after her Lunge poke.

core.why: The 47.1% win rate build path starts here; the on-hit slow lets you actually stick to Fiora after she Lunges away, which she can otherwise do freely twice per cooldown cycle.
Second item in the highest-performing measured path (47.1% over 34 games); attack speed compounds your short-trade damage before she can stack Duelist back to even.
Closes the build in the top-performing path; grievous wounds directly guts her passive healing, which is the stat that lets her win extended trades against you.

runes.keystoneWhy: This page measures 61.5% win rate over its sample, far ahead of the more popular Conqueror page's 43.4% in this exact matchup — Second Wind in the secondary tree directly answers Fiora's early poke damage, which is the main thing dragging Garen's overall win rate down here.

summoners.why: Run in 94.4% of games at 45% win rate; Ignite's damage-over-time seals kills after your Q silence and E burst, and pairs with Demacian Justice (R) for confirmed picks once she overextends on a Lunge.

playing.title: Open trades with E, not Q
playing.detail: Judgment (E) is a spin, not a basic attack, so it can't be parried by Riposte. Land E first, then decide whether to commit Q's empowered attack based on whether her Riposte is up.

playing.title: Track her Riposte cooldown
playing.detail: Riposte drops to as low as 6s cooldown at max rank, faster than your own Q's flat 8s. If you can't remember the last time she used it, assume it's up and don't feed your Q's follow-up attack into it.

playing.title: Punish both Lunge charges spent
playing.detail: Lunge can be used twice within a couple seconds for free, but after that she has no gap-close for 16 down to 8 seconds depending on rank. Wait for both dashes to be burned before you commit to an all-in.

playing.title: Keep trades short
playing.detail: Duelist stacks every time Fiora lands a hit on you, healing her more the longer the fight runs. Two-hit trades (E into Q) beat prolonged auto-attack exchanges where her sustain catches up.

playing.title: Watch for Burst of Speed before all-ins
playing.detail: Once she activates Burst of Speed (E), every hit or Lunge she lands during it stacks extra move speed, letting her chase or kite freely. If she's already used it, she has no speed tool left to escape your engage.

playing.title: Respect Blade Waltz from level 6
playing.detail: Her ultimate dashes to hit you from 400 range with the cooldown as low as 130s at rank 1; this is the level range where the data shows her solo-kill advantage peaks, so don't overextend past your wave once she hits 6.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, rune pages, and every win-rate or pick-rate figure above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning for why those numbers land where they do — the Riposte interaction, the trade timing, the cooldown windows — is our own tactical read, not something OP.GG reports.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let Fiora block your abilities with her Riposte(W). Be careful of her (P) while using your skills to deal damage whenever they come off cooldown.
